decisions.reason: As a low-carrying-cost service that directly complements the firm's core e-commerce and SEO offering and remained visible through 2024, it still has option value and shows no clear signal that its value has resolved negatively.

As a newly launched, low-cost workshop format closely tied to existing SEO capabilities, its market value is still uncertain enough that keeping it preserves upside while the firm has only a small set of active new-product options.
